native_mechanisms: Hang the two symbol strings on crossed rows/columns of posts so their meeting forms a lattice of sparse spark-cells, each cell's color (match/gap-out/gap-in) chosen by the crossing symbols.
Fold the lattice sheet along its slanting middle so all cells whose row+column sum is equal press flush into one crease (anti-diagonal) computed as a unit.
Read three stacked crease-layers (d, d-1, d-2) at once, take the cheapest of the three costs, and let the spent bottom layer drift off before folding the next crease forward.
core_technique: Anti-diagonal (wavefront) Needleman-Wunsch: per-diagonal SIMD (AVX2/AVX-512) max of diag+score and max(left,up)+gap over three rotating int16 diagonal buffers, with sequence b reversed so both operand streams are contiguous along each anti-diagonal; a two-row scalar NW is used only as an out-of-regime/allocation-failure fallback.
